findings.title: Description issues instructions to the model
findings.detail: Description of "get_events" contains imperative instructions directed at the AI assistant rather than describing the tool. This is the core tool-poisoning technique.

evidence.snippet: Returns the credit-market events the Stack has recorded, newest first: a venue's debt, collateral or borrow rate moving past its rule from one daily reading to …

findings.remediation: Treat the server as untrusted; the model may obey embedded instructions.

findings.title: Read-only tool requests dangerous parameters
findings.detail: Tool "get_liquidation_map" appears informational but accepts parameters (history) that enable code/file/secret access.

evidence.snippet: level, id, date, history, from, to, as_known_on

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_chart, get_event_post_kit, get_desk_rates · Private data: get_fund_holdings, get_balance_sheet, list_venues, get_venue, get_credit_state, get_credit_state_history, get_market_composition · Public sink: get_chart, get_corporate_instruments, get_events, get_event_post_kit, get_desk_rates, get_credit_state, get_market_composition · Destructive: get_chart, get_verification_bundle.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_chart, get_event_post_kit, get_desk_rates · Private data: get_fund_holdings, get_balance_sheet, list_venues, get_venue, get_credit_state, get_credit_state_history, get_market_composition · Public sink: get_chart, get_corporate_instruments, get_events, get_event_post_kit, get_desk_rates, get_credit_state, get_market_composition · Destructive: get_chart, get_verification_bundle

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
